description: Renovate keeps the Python and npm dependencies, the Docker images and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current.

Every update, major ones included, merges through GitHub native auto-merge once the required checks pass. Those checks build the watcher's image too, so a base image that no longer builds fails before it merges.
Renovate assigns a pull request to the repository owner only when its checks fail, so a stuck update arrives as a GitHub notification instead of sitting unmerged.
